comment: #995 K3-parity: the BOM part-id NAMING RULE is one contract across runtimes. Go (#736, resolve.go expandComponentInstances) and TS (bom.ts) must name composed part ids IDENTICALLY: structure copies `st-<componentId>-copy-N`, module-instance copies `mod-<componentId>-copy-N`, agregado units `agr-<agregadoId>[-instance-<instanceId>-]u<unitIndex>-<componentId>-copy-N` (the instance tag appears only when the same agregadoId is instantiated more than once, #388). Each test builds its own minimal catalog around this skeleton and asserts the exact expectedPartIds SEQUENCE (BOM order: structure, module, agregados). composeFrozenDrilling joins these ids against the frozen release program — a divergence here kills every composed release export.
